title: Which load balancer?
claim: The kind of traffic and the feature it needs decide the type of load balancer.
alt: A decision ladder with three questions. Traffic that must pass through virtual appliances leads to a Gateway Load Balancer; HTTP or HTTPS requests to route or inspect lead to an Application Load Balancer; static IP addresses, TCP or UDP lead to a Network Load Balancer.
